# Datamining: Mini Season "Night in the Crypt"

![Datamining: Mini Season `Night in the Crypt`](/uploads/573_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

[Update October 21, 2025] 2 missing pictures of the autopsy table are now also in the article

This new mini season is all about Halloween. Following the “Night of Mischief” event, the new mini season starts under the name “Night in the Crypt”. The “Creepy Burnt Ones” event is also running at the same time and there are also new rewards for the creepy Burnt Ones. More about this in the post.

### Period "Night in the Crypt" Mini Season

**October 21st, 2025 - November 4th, 2025 at 6 p.m.**

This mini season will also have a new area next to the season. If you press "Season" in the main menu, a selection will open in which you can choose the current season 22 or the mini season. In both you can collect the rewards with the same tickets.

Tickets are earned as usual through the daily and weekly challenges.

## Free Challenge Item

### Mortuary candy bowl

Share your mystery candy from the morgue candy bowl. The Morgue Candy Bowl is a container that contains mysterious candies in your C.A.M.P. outputs.

- THIS ITEM CANNOT BE BUILT IN A SHELTER.-

The challenge item this time is the "**Morgue Candy Bowl**", but in principle you can use any other candy bowl as well.

You also need **any costume**. You can see what counts as a costume here.

*Note:* This time it is again possible to complete the **Challenges in Power Armor**. There is a new function in the challenges called "WornInOrOutOfPowerArmor", which detects if you wear a costume before entering the PA and counts it towards the challenges.

| Complete the Hand Out Candy and Trick-or-Treat Final Challenges. | 4 | 

## Mini Season Rewards

### Autopsy table bed

The last bed you'll ever need!

### Vault-Tec body bag

Vault-Tec's best way to get rid of unwanted carcasses.

### Closed morgue drawer

Make morgue visitors feel really comfortable with the open morgue drawer.

### Morgue drawer

Spread a little fear among your C.A.M.P.'s visitors with the Morgue Drawer.

### Morgue sign

You're welcome...sometime.
